title: How to catch a Falcon
description: You would think catching an F-16 Fighting Falcon would be difficult, however it's something the 52nd CES prepares for every day. Last week The #PowerPro shop tested their aircraft arresting system, which serves as a protective measure in case of an In-Flight Emergency. In the event a pilot was having an IFE they would be able to touch down, deploy a hook and catch a cable that's part of the arresting system. This system ensures the safety of the pilot and the aircraft.
